meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Namecheap Hosting Review 2026: Prices, Speed, AI
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Namecheap hosting review for 2026: plan prices and renewals, a two-week Cybernews test, AI tools for WordPress, pros and cons, and who it suits.
meta.rl_answer: Namecheap suits a small first site on a low budget. Cybernews measured 99.29% uptime, and renewals are more than double the promo price.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Namecheap good for hosting? | It is good for a small first site on a low budget. Cybernews called it a great domain provider and weak web hosting.
How much does Namecheap hosting cost? | Promo prices start at $2.28 a month for Stellar. Renewal is $55.88 a year for Stellar, $85.44 for Stellar Plus and $128.88 for Stellar Business.
How reliable is Namecheap hosting? | Cybernews measured 99.29% uptime over two weeks. Namecheap itself claims a 100% uptime guarantee.
Is there a Namecheap money-back guarantee? | Namecheap lists 30 days for first-time shared customers. It does not apply together with the 30-day free period.
Does Namecheap have AI tools? | Yes. It lists AI for WordPress and Sitejet AI Website Builder on every shared plan. We did not test them.
Does Namecheap have a Black Friday sale? | The Black Friday page we read still referred to 2025. Check the page on the day you buy.
meta.rl_sources:
Namecheap: shared hosting (read 15 and 16 Nov 2026) | https://www.namecheap.com/hosting/shared/
Cybernews: Namecheap review (updated 15 May 2026) | https://cybernews.com/best-web-hosting/namecheap-review/
meta.rl_takeaways:
Promo prices start at $2.28 a month, and renewals are much higher.
Cybernews measured 99.29% uptime over two weeks.
Namecheap claims 100% uptime. The test result was lower.
AI for WordPress works on new WordPress installs only.
meta.rl_g_glossary:
Promo price | A low first-term price that rises at renewal.
LCP | Largest Contentful Paint, the time the biggest item on a page takes to appear.
Reachability | How often a monitoring tool could reach the site.
CDN | A network that serves copies of your pages from nearby servers.
